reason: Provides durable session checkpoints that mark where an exploration begins so a companion rewind workflow can later fold intermediate exploration out of model-visible context.

summaries.zh: 为会话持久化探索起点标记，供配套的 rewind 工作流稍后折叠中间过程并减少模型可见上下文噪声。
summaries.en: Persists session checkpoints that mark the start of an exploration for a companion rewind workflow to later fold intermediate steps out of the model-visible context.

capabilities: Persists checkpoint markers in plugin-owned local storage keyed by session ID
Supports later workflow consumption by a companion rewind plugin
